question.:question/problem: Find the fundamental vector product of the surface generated by the vector-valued function $r(u,v)=⟨u,\,4\left(u\operatorname{sin}⁡v\right),\,v\operatorname{cos}⁡u⟩.$

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}_{u}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂u},\,\frac{∂y}{∂u},\,\frac{∂z}{∂u}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂u}(u),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(4\left(u\operatorname{sin}⁡v\right)),\,\frac{∂}{∂u}(v\operatorname{cos}⁡u)⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\,4 \sin{(v )},\,-v\operatorname{sin}⁡u⟩ \\ {r}_{v}^{′} & =⟨\frac{∂x}{∂v},\,\frac{∂y}{∂v},\,\frac{∂z}{∂v}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{∂}{∂v}(u),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(4\left(u\operatorname{sin}⁡v\right)),\,\frac{∂}{∂v}(v\operatorname{cos}⁡u)⟩ \\  & =⟨0,\,4 u \cos{(v )},\,\operatorname{cos}⁡u⟩\end{aligned}

$$

$$
r(u,v)=⟨4 u + 4 v,\,v^{2} + \sin{(u )},\,u v⟩.

$$
